cases.sentence: Вот перечень израильтян — глав семейств, тысячников и сотников, и их чиновников, которые служили царю во всем, что относилось к ___, несшим службу по месяцу в течение года.
cases.explain: «войсковым отделениям» — after the preposition «к», the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: Now the children of Israel after their number, the heads of fathers’ households and the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and their officers who served the king, in any matter of the divisions which came in and went out month by month throughout all the months of the year—of every division were twenty-four thousand.

cases.sentence: Во главе ___ для первого месяца стоял Иашовеам, сын Завдиила.
cases.explain: «первого отделения» — after the preposition «во», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Over the first division for the first month was Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel: and in his division were twenty-four thousand.

cases.sentence: Во главе первого отделения для ___ стоял Иашовеам, сын Завдиила.
cases.explain: «первого месяца» — after the preposition «для», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Over the first division for the first month was Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel: and in his division were twenty-four thousand.

cases.sentence: Во главе отделения для ___ стоял ахохитянин Додай; его главным воеводой был Миклот.
cases.explain: «второго месяца» — after the preposition «для», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Over the division of the second month was Dodai the Ahohite, and his division; and Mikloth the ruler: and in his division were twenty-four thousand.

cases.sentence: Во главе отделения для второго месяца стоял ахохитянин Додай; его ___ был Миклот.
cases.explain: «главным воеводой» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: Over the division of the second month was Dodai the Ahohite, and his division; and Mikloth the ruler: and in his division were twenty-four thousand.

cases.sentence: ___ для третьего месяца был Ванея, сын священника Иодая.
cases.explain: «Третьим военачальником» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: The third captain of the army for the third month was Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada the chief priest. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

cases.translation: The third captain of the army for the third month was Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada the chief priest. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

cases.sentence: Это тот Ванея, который был ___ среди тех тридцати и начальником над ними.
cases.explain: «могучим воином» — after the preposition «среди», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: This is that Benaiah who was the mighty man of the thirty, and over the thirty: and of his division was Ammizabad his son.

cases.translation: The fifth captain for the fifth month was Shamhuth the Izrahite: and in his division were twenty-four thousand.

cases.explain: «шестого месяца» — after the preposition «для», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: The sixth captain for the sixth month was Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite: and in his division were twenty-four thousand.

cases.translation: The seventh captain for the seventh month was Helez the Pelonite, of the children of Ephraim. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

cases.translation: The eighth captain for the eighth month was Sibbecai the Hushathite, of the Zerahites. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

cases.explain: «девятого месяца» — after the preposition «для», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: The ninth captain for the ninth month was Abiezer the Anathothite, of the Benjamites. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

cases.sentence: Десятым для ___ был нетофитянин Магарай, потомок Зераха.
cases.explain: «десятого месяца» — after the preposition «для», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: The tenth captain for the tenth month was Maharai the Netophathite, of the Zerahites. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

cases.translation: The eleventh captain for the eleventh month was Benaiah the Pirathonite, of the children of Ephraim. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

cases.sentence: Двенадцатым для ___ был нетофитянин Хелдай, потомок Отниила.
cases.explain: «двенадцатого месяца» — after the preposition «для», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: The twelfth captain for the twelfth month was Heldai the Netophathite, of Othniel. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

cases.sentence: Азмавету, сыну Адиила, было поручено смотреть за ___.
cases.explain: «царскими кладовыми» — after the preposition «за», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: Over the king’s treasures was Azmaveth the son of Adiel: and over the treasures in the fields, in the cities, and in the villages, and in the towers, was Jonathan the son of Uzziah;

cases.sentence: Шаронитянину Шитраю — за ___, пасущемся в районе Шарон, а Шафату, сыну Адлая, за крупным скотом в долинах.
cases.explain: «крупным скотом» — after the preposition «за», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: and over the herds that fed in Sharon was Shitrai the Sharonite; and over the herds that were in the valleys was Shaphat the son of Adlai;

cases.sentence: Агаритянину Иазизу — за ___.
cases.explain: «мелким скотом» — after the preposition «за», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: All these were the rulers of the property which was king David’s.

cases.sentence: Ионафан, дядя Давида, ___ и писарь, был советником.
cases.explain: «проницательный человек» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Also Jonathan, David’s uncle, was a counselor, a man of understanding, and a scribe. Jehiel the son of Hachmoni was with the king’s sons.

cases.sentence: Ахитофел был ___.
cases.explain: «царским советником» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: Ahithophel was the king’s counselor. Hushai the Archite was the king’s friend.
